Subject: Coord: 30-min showcase — two primary windows + backup (post-discovery)

Hi Anya / Ben — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a concrete next step to get a 30-minute product showcase on the calendar.

Recap (2 bullets):
- You’re evaluating LLM inference for inference predictability (latency & cost) across hosted and private deployments.
- Primary evaluation criteria: predictable tail latency, ability to run in VPC, and audit/logging for SOC2 scope.

Proposed next step: a 30‑minute demo for stakeholders — keep it focused (10m infra + 15m product + 5m Q&A). Please pick the preferred window below or tell us constraints:

Option A (primary): Wed Jun 26 — 09:30–10:00 PT (12:30–13:00 ET)
Option B (primary): Thu Jun 27 — 14:00–14:30 PT (17:00–17:30 ET)
Backup: Mon Jul 1 — 11:00–11:30 PT (14:00–14:30 ET)

Stakeholders we recommend including: Product sponsor (you), Infrastructure/Platform owner, Security/compliance lead. If they have limited availability, pick the slot and let us know who will join.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (one-page agenda), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (draft MAP).

If you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-demo checklist.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,
Irene

Thanks, Irene — great summary. Ben and I reviewed the options with our schedule.

We can do Option B (Thu Jun 27 — 14:00 PT). Please add our Security lead (Ben Ortiz) as a required attendee — he’ll want to ask about data residency and audit logs.

A couple of quick asks before the demo:
- Can you confirm format: recording OK? We may want to circulate it to execs who can’t join.
- Please ensure the demo includes a 10-minute infra/deployment section (we care about VPC/on-prem options) and time to clarify SLAs.

Appreciate the agenda — I’ll review the MAP and share comments by EOD Wednesday.
